public_source_heads.source_scope: current cross-platform lock semantics used to refine candidate009/010; POSIX default flock, Windows exclusive msvcrt path, Windows shared locks require optional pywin32 in portalocker 4.x

exact_continuation: Start with the typed planner persistence-evidence and shared event-lock design as one coupled patch map: make FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN authoritative in LifeSupervisor retry, add invalid-UTF8 and malformed-target regressions, then map a real-Windows event-log exclusive-lock regression into the existing PORTABLE_TESTS matrix. Audit whether core.file_lock.exclusive_file_lock can safely gain an indefinite-wait mode for event-log authority without changing bounded callers; otherwise use an event-specific portalocker wrapper. Move iter_call_events and Mission View candidate006/007 to the same stable-generation primitive. Continue candidate008 durability and candidate005 transition_id provenance separately.

run_findings.candidate_010_single_production_caller: planner_verdict_was_persisted has one checked production caller outside its module: LifeSupervisor._retry_pending_planner_verdict; therefore a typed evidence helper can replace the critical boolean without broad migration
run_findings.candidate_010_tri_state_contract: FOUND => no re-emit; ABSENT only after complete stable snapshot => retry emit allowed; UNKNOWN => keep outbox pending and do not append another planner verdict
run_findings.candidate_010_corruption_refinement: current UTF-8 text scan catches only OSError; invalid UTF-8 raises UnicodeDecodeError, and malformed JSON containing the target delivery_id is skipped to False. Target-relevant decode/parse ambiguity must be UNKNOWN, not ABSENT
run_findings.candidate_010_scan_shape: scan stable snapshot as bytes, prefilter exact delivery-id bytes, parse candidate rows; malformed unrelated rows whose bytes cannot contain the target need not poison a target-specific absence proof
run_findings.candidate_009_lock_reuse: Argus already ships portalocker>=3 and core.file_lock.exclusive_file_lock; current portalocker default POSIX lock is flock and Windows exclusive works via msvcrt without pywin32, while Windows shared locks require optional pywin32. Reuse exclusive primitive for writer/Windows correctness path and preserve POSIX shared-flock pinning behind one event API
run_findings.candidate_009_timeout_caveat: exclusive_file_lock defaults to 30s but current event writer blocks indefinitely on POSIX flock; reusing it unchanged could convert prolonged reconciliation contention into event write failure. Add explicit indefinite mode or an event-specific indefinite wrapper before replacing writer locking
run_findings.candidate_009_ci_gap: Argus Windows/macOS portable CI already covers core file/daemon locks but no event-log module; add portable event-lock regression to PORTABLE_TESTS so no undeclared pywin32 dependency can hide
run_findings.candidate_010_iter_call_events: iter_call_events also enumerates generation pathnames then opens later; rollover can yield a false missing/partial exact call trace and event_log_query returns exit 1 on empty result. Move it to the same stable snapshot
run_findings.candidate_007_status: Mission View reconciliation should consume the same stable-generation primitive and preserve events.lock -> mission-view.lock ordering plus legacy-baseline migration
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate durability hypothesis; no power-loss incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
run_findings.connector_mutation_incident: Prior invocation created prohibited branch should-not-create. Root control13 plus role config6 now carry and this invocation enforced the explicit local read-only discovery/write-boundary guard; this invocation performed no connector probe mutation and wrote only authorized open_source state/receipt destinations. The old branch remains an external remediation item for a control plane with delete-ref capability.
